title: Picture Frame
text:
Picture Frame. What a cheap frame for the price. And seriously the way you have to hang this picture, with a string and two screws.
I do not want to put two holes in my wall. Wish I had not bought this frame.

product_metadata.title: ArtToFrames Collage Photo Frame Single Mat with 3-8x10 Openings with Satin Black Frame and Cognac mat.
features: Comes with Satin Black frame, Styrene, Cognac mat , backing and a wire hanging set (hardware as shown in the photos).
Finished Frame Dimensions: 14" x 30" (Total frame size when hanging on the wall).
Comes with 3 - 8x10 openings. (Each opening cut roughly 1/4" smaller then the size listed so it holds in your photos nicely)
High quality 4-ply single mat ... Lignin Free, pH-neutral. Bevel Cut Edges.

details.Warranty Description: 30 day money back guarantee, for damages during shipping all packaging must be saved for claims
